method.outcomes: paired_evaluation -> mean action costs; reference_decision_rollouts -> reference action; M0 costs + h*s_hat -> all rule decisions; indexed costs -> signed regrets and G_S
method.reference: Reference action chosen from R_dec rollouts, evaluated on separate R_eval rollouts; not min(V) or clipped regret.
method.B1_scope: h<=1800 and disagreement>=1%; evaluability is reported, not an exclusion
method.B2_scope: evaluable record,tau,h<=1800; max(mean fresh regret,mean stale regret)
method.B3a_scope: evaluable days, h in {3600,7200}; SE across daily instance means; both resolution gates required
method.B3b_scope: evaluable record,h in {3600,7200}; exact fluid ties; fresh counted once; signed sums preserved

B2.unit: record,tau,h; both-side=max(fresh regret,stale_tau regret), as X-GEANT

B3b.sum_scope: Sum of instance regrets over evaluable record,h; fresh occurs once per h.

3600.sum_scope: Sum of instance regrets over evaluable record,h; fresh occurs once per h.

7200.sum_scope: Sum of instance regrets over evaluable record,h; fresh occurs once per h.
